topics.description: Medicaid funding is a trending topic due to recent investigations and developments in Minnesota. The state's Medicaid funding has been under scrutiny, with federal officials signaling they will not cut funds. This has significant implications for the state's healthcare system and recipients of Medicaid benefits.

Child care fraud is a trending topic due to recent cases and guilty pleas. The Baltimore child care owner's sentencing and the Feeding our Future fraud case highlight the need for increased scrutiny and oversight in the child care industry.
